items.computation: Letter is dated Friday 27.03.2026. Period is set to begin 'nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens' (after the letter's date), so per §187(1) BGB the day of the event (27.03.) is excluded and counting starts on 28.03.2026. The letter itself defines 'Werktage' as Monday through Saturday excluding statutory holidays, so Sundays and legal holidays are skipped when counting the 10 working days. Counting forward from 27.03.2026: Sat 28.03 (day1), Sun 29.03 skipped, Mon 30.03 (day2), Tue 31.03 (day3), Wed 01.04 (day4), Thu 02.04 (day5), Fri 03.04 Karfreitag/Good Friday (NW public holiday, skipped), Sat 04.04 (day6), Sun 05.04 skipped, Mon 06.04 Ostermontag/Easter Monday (NW public holiday, skipped), Tue 07.04 (day7), Wed 08.04 (day8), Thu 09.04 (day9), Fri 10.04 (day10). The 10th working day is Friday 10.04.2026, which is itself a normal working day, so no further §193 BGB shift is needed.
